annotations.title: Financial-strength screen for up to 10 companies (Piotroski + Altman Z)

description: Financial-strength screen for up to 10 companies (Piotroski + Altman Z) — Screen up to 10 US public companies (tickers or CIKs, comma separated) in one call: Piotroski F-score (0-9) with failed tests, Altman Z and zone, a ranked table, average score, strong (7+) and weak (3 or less) lists, distress/grey-zone lists, the most common failed tests and a REVIEW screen line. Source: SEC EDGAR XBRL (public domain). Not investment advice. JSON. Price: $0.03 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_fscore_batch
